sentence: The hotel was expensive; furthermore, we enjoyed our stay.
ruleVi: Hai ý trái ngược nên dùng nevertheless (tuy vậy).

sentence: In the whole, the trip to Sa Pa was a success.
ruleVi: Cụm cố định On the whole = nhìn chung.

sentence: The flat is close to work. Nevertheless, the rent is cheap.
ruleVi: Thêm một ý cùng chiều nên dùng Furthermore.

sentence: Despite of the heavy rain, the match went ahead.
ruleVi: Despite + danh từ, không có of.

sentence: Minh studied hard. As result, he passed every exam.
ruleVi: Cụm cố định As a result = do đó.

sentence: In addition to speak English, Lan is learning Korean.
ruleVi: In addition to là giới từ nên theo sau là V-ing.

sentence: Phones are useful. On the contrary, they can be distracting.
ruleVi: Nêu mặt khác của vấn đề dùng On the other hand; On the contrary dùng để bác bỏ.

sentence: To summary up, the new road has brought more benefits than problems.
ruleVi: Cụm cố định To sum up = tóm lại.

sentence: Besides cheap, the market is very close to my house.
ruleVi: Besides là giới từ nên theo sau là V-ing: besides being.

sentence: He was tired, so that he went to bed early.
ruleVi: Chỉ kết quả dùng so; so that chỉ mục đích.
